body:
Morgan Stanley Direct Lending trades at a 32% discount to NAV, reflecting sector-wide pressures and a deteriorating credit book.

I maintain a Hold rating: non-accruals have risen to 2.9% of cost, NII per share and NAV have declined, and dividend coverage is now just 1.00×.

MSDL's liquidity is strong, leverage is moderate at 1.21×, and the Capstone JV offers incremental NII, but credit stability remains unproven.

The dividend, yielding 13.6%, appears safe for now with $0.86 per share spillover, but further credit deterioration or coverage slippage could force a reassessment.
